newsitem.title: UK: NWE diesel soft on oversupply,heat oil demand weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE diesel soft on oversupply,heat oil demand weak.

text.p: NWE diesel premiums came under further pressure on Monday from continuing supply from the U.S. market, but heating oil was steady at its already low level, traders said.
The weak sentiment on the cash market translated into heavy selling of IPE futures, where Nov fell $3.00 to $209.00 a tonne.
One trader saw a distressed 40,000 tonne cargo of U.S. diesel arriving on Nov 8-12 looking for a firm bid at Dec +$15.00 cif NWE.
Handy-sized cargoes were in slightly better demand, but one dealer saw more weakness in stall.
"It's not the end," he said, "There is more Algerian to come." He said two cargoes looked likely to sail to the north, but others could be tempted to sail east if prices there hold up.
Heating oil cargoes were steady at Dec +$7 cif Hamburg and barges remained in very thin demand at a small premium to the November IPE.
Russian cargoes suffered from the lack of barge buying, and were also valued at around Nov +$2.00 cif Roterdam.
